en.description:
Hoist the black flag and take to the skies!

Cloud Dancer is a side-scrolling airship shooter. You captain a steampunk pirate airship through four skies, broadsiding the King's Aerial Navy. Steer anywhere with your thumb; the cannons fire on their own.

FLY, FIGHT, HIDE
• Drag anywhere to steer — your thumb never covers the ship
• FULL STEAM: a ramming dash that shrugs off fire
• Duck into a cloud bank and the navy loses its aim
• Lightning in the Storm Wall, floating forts at sunset, and the very ceiling of the sky

THE KING'S AERIAL NAVY
• Gyrocopters, zeppelins, balloon mines, flak towers, sky pikes and cloud lurkers
• Four bosses: HMS Thunderer, the Tempest Engine, Fort Sovereign and the Brass Kraken
• Every boss warns you before it strikes

PLUNDER
• Chain shot, harpoon, rockets and a Gatling gun
• Gold, treasure chests and gun crates fly straight to you
• After every boss, the Sky Market: exploding shells, a five-ball broadside, heavy shot, a rear gunner, a steam shield, a squadron of up to four wingman airships and more
• Fit out your airship in the Hangar: paint, sails, a parrot, and upgrades that last every run
• Play with touch, a keyboard, a game controller or a TV remote

MADE TO PLAY
• Plays offline. No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no in-app purchases
• Original music
en.subtitle: A Pirate Airship Shooter
